title: Settings
intro: Manage your organisation, preferences, and security from one place.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Manage your personal information and preferences.

organization.title: Organisation settings
organization.description: Legal details, billing, and invoicing defaults for your organisation.

organizations.title: Organisations
organizations.placeholder: Creating and switching organisations is coming soon.

verifactu.title: Veri*Factu
verifactu.description: The digital certificate used to send your invoices' records to AEAT.

help.emailReadOnly: Email changes are not supported yet.
help.timeZone: Used for personal date and time preferences when available.
help.billingEmail: Customer replies to invoice emails will go to this address.
help.locale: Controls the language and formats used across the app and your invoices.
help.sessionIdleTimeoutMinutes: Users are asked to log in again after this many minutes without activity.
help.sessionAbsoluteLifetimeDays: Users are asked to log in again after this many days even if they stay active.
help.fiscalRegime: Only applies to organisations in Spain. With Veri*Factu, every issued invoice is sent to AEAT.

placeholders.paymentInstructions: Bank transfer details, payment terms, or customer-facing instructions

flash.organizationCreated: Organisation created. You can switch to it from the organisation selector.

security.sessionTimeoutsDescription: Control how long organisation sessions remain valid.
security.changePasswordDescription: Update your password. Other active sessions for your account will be signed out.
security.activeSessionsDescription: Review where your account is signed in and revoke sessions you no longer recognise.

organizations.currentDescription: New customers, items, and invoices are created inside this organisation.
organizations.newDescription: Create a separate organisation with its own legal details, billing defaults, customers, items, invoices, and numbering.
organizations.createDescription: Create a separate organisation with its own customers, items, invoices, and numbering.

verifactu.notApplicable: Veri*Factu only applies to organisations in Spain on the Veri*Factu regime. Your organisation doesn't send records to AEAT.
verifactu.noCertificate: There's no certificate. Invoices can still be issued, but their records won't be sent to AEAT until you upload one.
verifactu.expired: This certificate has expired. Upload a new one to keep sending records to AEAT.
verifactu.unreadable: This certificate can't be read with the server's current encryption key. Upload it again to keep sending records to AEAT.
verifactu.nifMismatch: The certificate's NIF ({certificateNif}) doesn't match the organisation's NIF ({organizationNif}). AEAT only accepts submissions if the holder can file on the organisation's behalf.
verifactu.certificateHelp: The certificate and its password are stored encrypted and are never shown again.
verifactu.removeDescription: This organisation's Veri*Factu records will stop being sent to AEAT until you upload another certificate.

errors.invalidPassword: The password isn't correct for this certificate.
errors.unsupportedFormat: This file uses old encryption that isn't supported. Export it again with AES-256 or TripleDES encryption.
errors.missingPrivateKey: The file doesn't include the private key. Export the certificate together with its private key.
errors.invalidFile: The certificate couldn't be read. Check it's a .p12 or .pfx file.
errors.notYetValid: This certificate is not valid yet. Upload it once its validity period has started.
